points.description: Correct symbolic linearised state-space matrices with states x=[δθ, δθ̇]: A = [[0,1],[-mgℓ cos(θe)/J, -b/J]], B = [0; 1/J]. Must use cos(θe) (not sin) and correct negative signs in A21 and A22. Linearisation may be written in deviation variables.

levels.says: Structure mostly right but one error, e.g. sin used instead of cos, or a sign error on A21 (this is the listed common error; see notes).

points.description: Correct numerical entries: A = [[0,1],[-61.3,-2.5]] (A21 ≈ -61.3, A22 = -2.5) and B = [0; 50]. Numerical value consistent with the student's own expression may earn this mark only if the arithmetic is correct and B includes 1/J.

levels.says: A numerically correct but B wrong (e.g. [0;1]), or B correct and A21 wrong.

rubric.notes: Full marks: correct symbolic form with cos(θe) and signs, plus A = [[0,1],[-61.3,-2.5]], B = [0;50]. Using sin(θe) (-106.2) or a sign error on A21 loses the symbolic mark; the numerical mark is allowed only if consistent and B correct, max 1. Forgetting 1/J in B (B=[0;1]) loses the numerical mark, max 1. Measuring θe from horizontal (cos30°) loses the symbolic mark.
